# Coachella announces 2027 dates

The Indio Valley festival wrapped up its 2026 edition less than two days ago — relive highlights

Credit: Facebook

Coachella, already looking ahead to its next edition, has announced its 2027 festival dates.

Less than two days out from its 2026 festival finale, Coachella revealed it will return to California's Indio Valley for its usual two weekends: 9th to 11th April, and the following weekend, 16th to 18th April. Tickets will be on sale via the [Coachella website](https://coachella.com/passes) from 1st May. The 2026 line-up was announced in September the previous year, so expect 2027 artist details to drop in early autumn.

Coachella 2026 wrapped up its second weekend this past Sunday, 19th April, after running over two weekends in the Indio desert.
Coachella organisers Goldenvoice will host a one-off electronic music-focused festival Head Trip at the Empire Polo Club in Indio Valley on 10th and 11th October. Calvin Harris, Four Tet back-to-back with Peggy Gou, Floating Points' Sunflower Sound System, The Blessed Madonna, Swedish House Mafia are among the already announced acts.
Relive highlights from Coachella 2026: Nine Inch Nails and Boys Noize debut as Nine Inch Noize ; The xx 's return; PinkPantheress performing ‘Illegal’, ‘Stars’ and ‘Girl Like Me’ and bringing out Janelle Monáe, Zara Larsson and Blood Orange as guests; Madonna joining Sabrina Carpenter for 'Vogue' and 'Like a Prayer' ; DJ Snake headlining the Quasar Stage ; Moby playing 'Porcelain', 'Natural Blues' and 'When It's Cold I'd Like To Die' (he later announced he's donating his fees to animal rights organisations ); David Guetta's debut with Marten Hørger as Men Machine and previously with Jennifer Lopez ; and Anyma and LISA joining Marlon Hoffstadt 's DJ set after their first night set was cancelled due to windy conditions.

Here’s what you need to know.

## What is Coachella?

The Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival is an annual music festival held over two weekends in Indio, just east of [Palm Springs](https://www.timeout.com/palm-springs) .

## When is Coachella?

The festival is held over two weekends, **April 9–11 and April 16–18, 2027** .

## Where is Coachella?

Not in the city of Coachella, surprisingly. Though most of us simply refer to the fest as Coachella, it’s technically the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival. So the event actually takes place at the Empire Polo Club, a large field in the city of Indio (which is part of the larger Coachella Valley, a desert area a couple of hours east of L.A. in Riverside County).

## When do Coachella tickets go on sale?

[Presale for the 2027 fest](https://coachella.com/passes) starts Friday, May 1, 2026 at 11am.
Expect those to sell out quite quickly, but you can count on another round of tickets to go on sale once the lineup is announced, sometime between the fall of 2026 and the winter of 2027.

## How much are Coachella tickets?

We hope you’ve been saving up (all of the following prices include fees): General admission for 2027 starts at $599 for weekend one and $549 for weekend two. Shuttle combo tickets start at $729 for the first weekend and $679 for the second. For VIP, passes start at $1,299 for weekend one and $1,249 for weekend two. (All of these prices tend to increase by $50 to $100 if you’re not among the first to grab tickets.) Check out the Coachella website for a wide range of [camping rates](https://www.coachella.com/passes) , as well as info on the [payment plan](https://coachella.com/pass-order-info) .

WASHINGTON (SBG) - After having to put their yearly festival on ice due to the coronavirus pandemic, [Coachella](https://coachella.com/) has announced an official return in April 2022.

Organizers of the music and arts festival announced on Tuesday, Coachella will be returning April 15-17 and April 22-24, 2022, being held on back-to-back weekends.
"See you in the desert," a post from Coachella's Twitter account reads.

[View post on X](https://twitter.com/i/web/status/1399772462422773761)

Since its debut in 1999, Coachella has become one of the world's largest and most famous music festivals. Coachella was one of the first festivals to react when the pandemic hit the U.S. in 2020, originally moving its date from April 2020 to October 2020, before being pushed again to April 2021.

While the lineup for its return has not been released, tickets for Coachella 2022 will be available on June 4th at 10 a.m. PST.
